title: A melted fuse in Meera's house
body: Meera's house receives a 220 V AC supply. The wiring has two separate circuits: a 5 A circuit for bulbs and fans, and a 15 A power circuit for appliances with higher power ratings. All appliances are connected in parallel between the live and neutral wires, and each has its own switch. One winter evening, Meera used a multi-plug to run a 1000 W room heater, a 1000 W electric iron and a 1500 W electric kettle together from a single socket of the 15 A power circuit. A few minutes later, the fuse of that circuit melted and all three appliances stopped. An electrician later checked the house: the insulation of all wires was intact, the earth wire was properly connected, and none of the appliances had any fault.
